style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, warm golden interior light
motion_rule: she sits in a tall leather chair the whole clip and the chair keeps its spot on the floor; everything else works: the courier moth crosses close to the lens in EVERY beat, papers are hauled across the frame in EVERY beat, and she throws something at the lens in EVERY beat; twice she kicks the floor and the chair spins hard, at 1.8 and 7.9, the lit city sweeping behind her; new side of the chair and new shot size every beat; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a rich brown mink coat with a huge lush collar, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, in a tall leather office chair
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a headset, always within a wing of the lens, hauling papers and folders across the frame in every beat
props: ONE battered leather briefcase crammed with papers at her feet; ONE gold lipstick; ONE round mirror on the desk; furry mic bottom right
environment: a rich top floor office in a skyscraper, floor to ceiling glass behind the chair, the low sun over the sea and the city lights below, the office bright and warm, a wide polished desk

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, flat and bored, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-3.9 one breath, short breath at 3.9, 3.9-6.0 one breath; after 6.0 only sfx
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: papers rustling all clip, paper tearing, fur ripping, the chair creaking, a cap snapping at 8.7
